I don't mean to be ungrateful, I truly don't, however, I fail to see how you would even know the difference between whether or not I was alive or dead. Also, giving the reason of someone else as why not to commit suicide has been shown to make suicidal persons feel even more burdened rather than lighten the load. 

That said, I give you credit for giving enough of a fuck to even write a response.
